sections.heading: Government Role
sections.text: The government manages the economy through policies, laws, and regulations.

sections.heading: Impact on Personal Finance
sections.text: Taxes, interest rates, subsidies, and regulations affect income and expenses.

sections.heading: Fiscal Policy
sections.text: Government spending and taxation used to control economic growth.

sections.heading: Monetary Policy
sections.text: Controlled by the central bank to manage money supply and interest rates.

sections.heading: Central Bank
sections.text: Regulates money, controls inflation, sets interest rates, and issues currency.

sections.heading: Financial Regulation
sections.text: Ensures fair markets and protects consumers from fraud.

sections.heading: Daily Impact
sections.text: Government decisions affect prices, jobs, and loan costs.
